MASTERCLASS_LESSON_3.title: Lesson 3 (Slides 1679-1694): The #1 Confirmation Mistake — Pullback Scale vs. Internal Micro-Breaks
MASTERCLASS_LESSON_3.question: Why do traders get stopped out when zooming into lower timeframes for confirmation, and what does proper confirmation look like?
MASTERCLASS_LESSON_3.answer: Confirmation must break the last meaningful HH/HL of the full pullback structure right off the retest zone, not a tiny internal push.
MASTERCLASS_LESSON_3.principle: The pullback starts from the Breakout HH/LL and finishes at the Retest Area. A tiny break inside the final push only shows the push is pausing—not that the pullback has ended. Proper confirmation occurs when price completes the retest into the zone, reacts away, and breaks the relevant pullback-scale HH/HL right near the zone.
MASTERCLASS_LESSON_3.cot_reasoning: Anchor entries strictly at the retest zone exit upon breaking the pullback-scale swing high/low (<= 0.38 ATR from zone), preventing premature entries inside the pullback and late entries that ruin R:R.
